skills.name: text-to-speech
skills.purpose: Official ElevenLabs TTS skill: voiceovers and speech in 90+ languages with voice selection, models and settings via SDK/API.
skills.how_to_use: Triggers on voiceover/TTS requests; needs ELEVENLABS_API_KEY (see setup-api-key skill).

skills.name: speech-to-text
skills.purpose: Official ElevenLabs Scribe v2 transcription: subtitles, meeting transcripts, diarisation and timestamps.
skills.how_to_use: Triggers on transcription/subtitle tasks; needs ELEVENLABS_API_KEY.

skills.name: music
skills.purpose: Official ElevenLabs Music API skill: instrumentals, songs with lyrics, jingles, with composition plans for section-level control.
skills.how_to_use: Triggers on music generation; needs ELEVENLABS_API_KEY.

skills.name: sound-effects
skills.purpose: Official ElevenLabs sound-effect generation from text: ambiences, impacts, UI sounds, with looping and duration control.
skills.how_to_use: Triggers on SFX requests; needs ELEVENLABS_API_KEY.

skills.name: speech
skills.purpose: OpenAI's TTS skill: narration, voiceover, accessibility reads and batch speech via the OpenAI Audio API with a bundled CLI.
skills.how_to_use: Triggers on TTS requests; needs OPENAI_API_KEY.
skills.evidence: Official OpenAI curated skill; skills.sh ~3.3K installs; mirrored in aitmpl/claude-code-templates

skills.name: transcribe
skills.purpose: OpenAI's transcription skill with optional diarisation and known-speaker hints for interviews and meetings.
skills.how_to_use: Triggers on transcribe requests; needs OPENAI_API_KEY.
skills.evidence: Official OpenAI curated skill; skills.sh ~3.6K installs

skills.name: media-use
skills.purpose: HyperFrames' media OS: resolves BGM, SFX, voices and LUTs into local files, generates TTS/music when the catalog misses, and produces voiceover, transcription and captions via one audio engine.
skills.how_to_use: Used inside HyperFrames projects; local TTS/whisper or provider keys as configured.
skills.evidence: Official HeyGen; skills.sh ~644K installs; #6 on skills.sh Hot list (+37)
skills.notes: PRIVACY: sends anonymous usage events to PostHog by default (scripts/lib/telemetry.mjs); see references/meta.md to turn it off.

skills.name: dubbing
skills.purpose: Official ElevenLabs dubbing: translate audio/video into other languages preserving speakers' voices, review/correct transcripts and regenerate.
skills.how_to_use: Needs ELEVENLABS_API_KEY.

skills.name: voice-changer
skills.purpose: Official ElevenLabs speech-to-speech: convert a recording into a different target voice while keeping emotion and timing (character voices, re-voicing narration).
skills.how_to_use: Needs ELEVENLABS_API_KEY; use a voice you have rights to.

skills.name: hyperframes-audio
skills.purpose: Mixes audio in HyperFrames compositions: fades, crossfades, gain automation, ducking/voiceover carve, EQ/compressor/limiter/reverb chains and submix buses.
skills.how_to_use: Use once audio is placed in a HyperFrames composition.

skills.name: podcast-generation
skills.purpose: Converts written content into a two-host conversational podcast script and synthesised audio.
skills.how_to_use: Triggers on 'make a podcast from this'; configure the TTS provider used by DeerFlow.

skills.name: notebooklm
skills.purpose: Operates Google NotebookLM through the unofficial notebooklm-py CLI/API: manage notebooks/sources and generate/download artifacts including Audio Overview podcasts.
skills.how_to_use: Needs notebooklm-py installed and a Google login.
skills.notes: SECURITY: drives your Google account by extracting browser cookies; installs uv via curl | sh. Use only with a separate account. Unofficial API using browser auth - Google ToS risk.

skills.name: minimax-music-gen
skills.purpose: Official MiniMax music generation: songs, lyrics, instrumentals and covers from mood/scene prompts, multilingual.
skills.how_to_use: Needs MiniMax API key.

skills.name: audiocraft-audio-generation
skills.purpose: Meta AudioCraft: MusicGen text-to-music, AudioGen text-to-sound and melody-conditioned generation, run locally in PyTorch.
skills.how_to_use: Needs Python/PyTorch and ideally a GPU.
skills.evidence: AI-Research-SKILLs (13.2k stars); also shipped in Hermes Agent optional skills

skills.name: songwriting-and-ai-music
skills.purpose: Songwriting craft (structure, prosody, hooks, rhyme) plus how to write effective Suno prompts and lyric formatting.
skills.how_to_use: Use for lyric writing and Suno prompting; no API needed.

skills.name: acestep
skills.purpose: Local AI music with ACE-Step 1.5: background music, vocal tracks, covers, stem extraction, repainting and continuation for video production.
skills.how_to_use: Needs the ACE-Step model locally or on RunPod per the toolkit.

skills.name: tts
skills.purpose: Text-to-speech with emotion control and voice cloning via NoizAI, including EPUB/PDF/SRT/article-to-audio conversion.
skills.how_to_use: Needs NoizAI API key (or local backend per README).

skills.name: edge-tts
skills.purpose: Free TTS via `uvx edge-tts` (Microsoft Edge voices) with voice, rate, pitch and format options.
skills.how_to_use: Needs uv; no API key.

skills.name: asr-transcribe-to-text
skills.purpose: Speaker-labelled transcription of audio/video (who said what), MLX-local on Apple Silicon or remote, from files or media URLs.
skills.how_to_use: Needs MLX/whisper models locally or a remote ASR endpoint.

skills.name: voice-isolator
skills.purpose: Official ElevenLabs voice isolation: remove noise/music from dialogue and extract vocals before transcription or editing.
skills.how_to_use: Needs ELEVENLABS_API_KEY.
